payouts._comment: GROUND TRUTH for the money function. All objective math derives from this file. PER-SEASON keyed by year (master sheet, 2026-08-08): the structure CHANGED across eras, so money math must pick the season's own config. `current` mirrors the active season (2026) for the money-function default + backward compat. E[$] = Sum_w P(weekly-high,w)*weekly + P(RS champ)*champ + P(RS 2nd)*runner_up + Sum_k P(finish k)*playoff[k], using THAT season's amounts.
payouts.weekly_high_scope_note: Master sheet (in writing): the weekly-$100 high is REGULAR SEASON ONLY — weeks 1-15 pay, playoff weeks do not.

2023.note: League year one — SMALLER pot. Corrects the earlier era-mismatch: Cory's 2023 THIRD paid $400, not $475.

2024.note: Playoffs 675/550/500/400 — DIFFERS from 2026. Corrects MarianSaar 2nd=$550 (not 575), cashworth 3rd=$500 (not 475).

2026.note: ACTIVE season. Playoffs changed 2nd/3rd to 575/475 vs 2024-25's 550/500.

2027.note: PLANNED reversion (playoff 2nd/3rd back to 550/500) + a $500 buy-in vote PENDING. Not final — the January rollover diff (Part 12 / Annual) catches the outcome. Do not use for grading.

regular_season.tiebreak_note: Master sheet rules tab (confirmed): RS ties break on TOTAL POINTS. Corroborated by Cory's 2024 8.2-point tiebreak miss.

weekly_high.note: 37.5% of the pot — regular season only, paid to the league-high score each week.

regular_season.note: Rewards consistent winning; the floor still buys RS money + playoff entry.

playoffs.note: Flat gradient: top-4 ENTRY (~$400 floor) is the real prize.

draft.note: Draft is UNTIMED (pick_timer=0 at source). Hard time-pressure cues dropped; the LRM countdown counts PICKS.

rules.pick_trade_note: League rule (master sheet): traded picks must swap within ONE round of each other — a hard constraint for the pick-trade valuator.
rules.pending_votes_note: Live governance on the Votes tab — 2027 config may move; the January rollover diff covers it.

payouts._data_spine_note: The master sheet's own TOTAL column is STALE (excludes 2025 for several owners) — the exact disease the data spine cures. Career money derives from YEAR columns, never the sheet Total.

predicted_keepers.note: PREDICTED slates for MOCK/REHEARSAL ONLY — never applied to the live board (Cory, 2026-08-11: a prediction rendered indistinguishably from a fact IS a fact as far as behaviour is concerned). Real designations are read from live Sleeper by the nightly draft-data rebuild; there is no keeper-watch process. Assumes keeper-eligibility (max_years=3 not verifiable for opponents).

keeper_slate.reason: 4/10 team(s) have designated on Sleeper and NO keeper placements exist on the draft yet, so nothing here is confirmed. 6 team(s) have not designated — unknown, not assumed empty.

withheld_from_board.reason: designations exist but the slate is not confirmed; applying a partial slate would make the board look authoritative and move once BEFORE the move that matters

arithmetic_check.rule: my_first_pick == (N*teams) + (my_slot if N+1 odd else teams+1-my_slot), N = MY keeper count
arithmetic_check.independent_of: how many players any other team keeps
arithmetic_check.condition: TRUE ONLY WHILE I KEEP EXACTLY 3. The RULE holds for any keeper count; the NUMBER moves with mine. First pick is the (N+1)th entry of the pre-keeper snake: keep 0 -> 8, keep 1 -> 13, keep 2 -> 28, keep 3 -> 33.
